statement: ∀ (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (r : ℝ), 0 < Metric.ediam U → Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r → 0 < Metric.diam U ∧ Metric.diam U ≤ r ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam U) = Metric.ediam U
proof:
intro U r hpos hle
have hfin : Metric.ediam U ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hle
have hr : 0 ≤ r := le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle))
refine ⟨?_, ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hr hle, ?_⟩
· exact ENNReal.toReal_pos hpos.ne' hfin
· exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfin

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            ∀ (r ε : ℝ),
              0 < r →
                r ≤ 1 →
                  0 < ε →
                    ∃ T U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : ↑T), (U i).Nonempty ∧ 0 < Metric.ediam (U i) ∧ Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) ∧
                          YuiCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
      ∀ (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (r : ℝ),
        0 < Metric.ediam U →
          Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
            0 < Metric.diam U ∧ Metric.diam U ≤ r ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam U) = Metric.ediam U
